entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.1932 of 2023, pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Bhadrak, arising out of Bhadrak Town P.S. Case No.455 of 2023 for commission of alleged offences under Sections 342/376(2)(n)/379/506/34 of IPC read with Section 66(E)/67 of I.T. Act.
3. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for pre-arrest bail.

4. Taking into account that the principal accused has been released on bail and on a conspectus of materials on record, the ABLAPL is disposed of with the observation that the Petitioner may surrender before the learned S.D.J.M., Bhadrak in connection with the aforementioned case within one month from today.

In the event of his surrender and motion for bail, the same be considered by the learned S.D.J.M.,
Bhadrak on merits, in the first hour of the day.
In the event of rejection of the prayer for bail by the learned S.D.J.M., Bhadrak, the Petitioner is at liberty to move the higher forum for bail in the second hour on the same day.
5. On being so moved, the higher forum is requested to make an endeavor to dispose of the bail application of the Petitioner on the same day.
The case diary be made available to the concerned Pranati Panda vs State Of Odisha ....
